description: This file contains unit tests for utility classes in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package, specifically testing serialization, deserialization, error injection during IO operations, and factory-based object retrieval.

classes.name: ErrorInjector
classes.description: A custom FilterInputStream subclass designed to inject IO exceptions during read and close operations for testing error handling.

classes.name: SerializationInjector
classes.description: A serializable class that can throw IOExceptions during serialization or deserialization based on specified flags for testing.

methods.name: testErrorInjector
methods.description: Unit test for ErrorInjector class, verifying exception injection during read and close methods.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: JUnit @After method to reset certain properties after each test run.

methods.name: testGetBytesObject
methods.description: Tests UtilObject.getBytes() with various Serializable objects including error scenarios.

methods.name: testGetObject
methods.description: Verifies deserialization from byte arrays, including handling of class not found and deserialization restrictions.

methods.name: testGetByteCount
methods.description: Checks the byte size calculation for long and verifies exception for unsupported object types.

methods.name: testDoHashCode
methods.description: Validates the doHashCode utility with different inputs, including null and arrays.

methods.name: testGetObjectFromFactory
methods.description: Tests retrieval of objects from factories based on sets of string keys, including exception handling.

methods.name: testGetObjectExceptionSafe
methods.description: Test deserialization of trusted object types with safe allow list.

methods.name: testGetObjectExceptionCustomized
methods.description: Tests deserialization with customized allow list settings.

methods.name: testGetObjectExceptionUnsafe
methods.description: Expects a ClassCastException when deserializing objects not on the allow list, verifying security restrictions.
